GoW3 2.1.8 Mali-G615 PanVK full-device freeze mitigation — consolidated signed APK
Source: a7dfb3d5ec70c8fd8aa2c9571a363323fb2241f5
Validated source tests: https://github.com/erickmendes22/gow3_android_daedalus_fork/actions/runs/41196965495
New: non-sparse arenas use 32 MiB and zero initialize, 1536 MiB cumulative
allocation ceiling including obsolete merged arenas; PanVK-only defaults to two
in-flight submissions, one compiler, one guest frame ahead, and no warm-up
or stale/deferred readback. Snapdragon/Adreno and system Vulkan unchanged.
This is the first native APK compile of this consolidated freeze mitigation.
